# Local Boys Storage

> Family-owned storage in Collingwood, Ontario. Secure, local, and affordable 8 by 20 foot units serving South Georgian Bay.

## Pages

- [Home](https://localboysstorage.ca/): Welcome, features, container sizes, and frequently asked questions.
- [Storage Units](https://localboysstorage.ca/storage-units): Unit size, security, and rental options.
- [Contact Us](https://localboysstorage.ca/contact-us): Phone, email, and message form.
